title: Runtime Market
description: A fictional US online marketplace over two years (2024–2025): customers, sellers, products, orders, order lines, payments and reviews. Generated by Runtime with realistic seasonality, repeat buyers, price changes, cancellations, returns, refunds and late deliveries. Every name and email is invented.

customers.description: One row per customer account. Some customers never ordered.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Unique, lowercase in the clean table

columns.name: city
columns.description: Profile city; empty when the customer never filled it in

columns.name: signup_at
columns.description: Account creation, UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS). Some accounts predate 2024

products.description: The catalogue. Products can launch during the period or be discontinued.

columns.name: list_price
columns.description: Current shelf price in USD; order lines record the price paid

columns.name: weight_kg
columns.description: Shipping weight; missing for some products

columns.name: launched_on
columns.description: First day the product could be ordered

columns.name: discontinued_on
columns.description: Last listing date; empty if still sold

orders.description: One row per order. Totals are subtotal + shipping_fee + tax.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: O + 6 digits. Increases day by day, but not by time within a day: sort by ordered_at for time order

columns.name: status
columns.description: processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled or returned (as of 2025-12-31)

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Sum of line totals after discount

columns.name: shipped_at
columns.description: Empty for processing and cancelled orders

order_items.description: Order lines. unit_price is the price at order time, which can differ from today's list_price.

columns.name: line_no
columns.description: Line number in the order, starting at 1

columns.name: line_total
columns.description: quantity × unit_price × (1 − discount_rate), rounded to cents

payments.description: Payment events. An order can have a failed attempt, a split gift-card payment, a cancelled card hold or a refund (negative amount).

columns.name: method
columns.description: card, paypal, apple_pay, gift_card or bank_transfer

reviews.description: Product reviews written after delivery. Late deliveries and returns get lower ratings.
